upgrade: a store written by an older kb, refused, then migrated and used.

The store's index database is a frozen schema-v7 file (the newest version before the one in
this build) holding a few entries and six logged searches. kb refuses it and says what to run.
migrate up backs the file up first, and the search log survives the upgrade.

  $ kb init --model none
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model none)

  $ rm .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite

  $ mkfixture index-v7 .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite

  $ kb search checkpoint --mode fts
  [stderr] kb search: store database $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite is at schema v7; this kb needs v8. Run: kb migrate up (with the same --store, if any)
  [exit 1]

  $ kb doctor
  ok   config: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  ok   sources: 1 configured: "data" (entries)
  FAIL migrate: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite is at schema v7, this kb needs v8 (index/0008-prior); run kb migrate up
  ok   model: none: FTS-only index and search
  ok   entries: 0 entries valid
  ok   index.md: absent (optional export)
  ~ ok   version: kb \(version\) at .*
  doctor: 1 failed, 0 warnings
  [stderr] kb doctor: 1 check(s) failed
  [exit 1]

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION   STATE                         PATH
  location       location     v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v7 -> v8  1 pending: run kb migrate up  $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -         not created yet               $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

  store default index:
    index/0008-prior  add search_results.prior and search_candidates.prior
  [exit 1]

The dry run reports the steps and the backup it would write, and changes nothing: the status
still says v7 and no backup file exists.

  $ kb migrate up --dry-run
  would migrate store default index: v7 -> v8 ($WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite)
    backup would be written to $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v7-(time)
    would apply index/0008-prior: add search_results.prior and search_candidates.prior

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION   STATE                         PATH
  location       location     v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v7 -> v8  1 pending: run kb migrate up  $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -         not created yet               $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

  store default index:
    index/0008-prior  add search_results.prior and search_candidates.prior
  [exit 1]

  $ ! exists .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-*

migrate up backs the file up and applies the step (this one clears nothing, so no reindex is
needed).

  $ kb migrate up
  migrated store default index: v7 -> v8 ($WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite)
    backup: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v7-(time)
    applied index/0008-prior: add search_results.prior and search_candidates.prior

  $ exists .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v7-*

  $ kb migrate verify
  ok   location kb.toml
  ok   store default config.toml
  ok   store default kb.sqlite

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION  STATE            PATH
  location       location     v1       current          $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1       current          $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v8       current          $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -        not created yet  $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

The fixture's six logged searches are still there: the new search is number 7, and the
overview counts all seven.

  $ kb search checkpoint --mode fts --caller claude
  search 7 · 1 hit
  [1] alpha.md › Body
  checkpoint starvation
  search_id=7
